dct_title_s: King County, Washington : Shoreline Management Program
dct_description_sm: Abstract: King County, Washington Shoreline Management Master Program.

Purpose: This data is utilized by permit review staff to determine if development proposals are within the extent of a shoreline management area, and if so, to identify the shoreline environment designation. Once determined, the appropriate shoreline development regulations can be applied to the proposal.

Supplemental information: All shoreline designations include "associated" wetland and floodplains whether or not they are indicated explicitly in the water feature's description. The layer was derived from legal descriptions taken from the King County Shoreline Management Master Program and supplemented with SAO Wetland and FEMA Floodplain data taken from the King County Sensitive Areas Ordinance.
dct_rights_sm: Use constraints: For educational non-commercial use only. This data may not be redistributed by HGL users. King County data are made available with the understanding that they shall be used exclusively by the obtainer or his/her authorized agents.
Access constraints: Access is granted to Harvard University Affiliates only. Affiliates are limited to current faculty, staff and students.
